_comment: Read by Deploy-Image.ps1 inside WinPE. Leave share.path empty for USB-only use. Everything else about a deployment is in AnswerFiles\*.xml. The wds section is read only by the console and Publish-WdsBootImage.ps1. The multicast section is read by Deploy-Image.ps1 (from the content root copy) and Set-WdsMulticast.ps1.

reporting._comment: Optional. Where PCs report progress for the console's Dashboard. Empty = <content root>\Status. Set a UNC path (e.g. \\deploy-server\Deploy\Status) so USB deployments report to a server too.

checks._comment: Post-deploy checks at the end of first boot, reported to the Dashboard. bitLocker: Auto (required when the answer file turns BitLocker on), Required, Report or Off. deviceErrors: Required, Report or Off. ignoreDevices: wildcards for device names or ids to skip.
